terms.comment: Traupman’s word, with biologia, biology, and biologus, a biologist (Traupman 279). For “living, natural” in a general sense, Latin uses vīvus or nātūrālis.

evidence: Cic. Phil. 3.15: nātūrālis pater, opposed to the adoptive father (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Of a father, a son, a grandson: by birth, not by adoption. Its general sense is “natural” (see natural).

phrases.latin: Pater ejus nātūrālis in Graeciā vīvit.
phrases.english: His biological father lives in Greece.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 279.
